rationale: First-shot defaults hit 2/7 (W4 ✓ WR=48%, W6 ✓ WR=42.9% +17% ann); avg_ann -4.1% beats both baselines (random_topk -30%, rule_only -28%); W7 has +44% ann at WR=36.4% (1.7pp from floor). Threshold sweep is FLAT across all 7 windows (every thr in [0.0, 0.7] picks identical trade set) — classic score-collapse fingerprint seen in ROCKET #1625 and FreTS #1561. Train mode should sweep calibration first (pos_weight ∈ [1.0, 2.5] but never ≤1.2 per FreTS lesson, dropout ∈ [0.0, 0.3], lr ∈ [1e-4, 5e-3]), then capacity (embedding_dim ∈ {32, 64, 128}, num_blocks ∈ {2, 3, 4}). The brief specifically warned not to over-rotate HPs to chase W5 (no monotonic prior), so DD-control HPs should target W3/W7 instead.
